CHAOS_POWER.title: Chaos
CHAOS_POWER.description: Every 3 cards you play, trigger a random effect: discard a card / lose 3 Max HP / gain 20 Spore / lose 20 Heat / gain 4 Zhongdu / lose 1 Energy / take 5 damage / Binbang gains 1 Thorns / add Exhaust to a random card in your hand.
CHAOS_POWER.smartDescription: Every 3 cards you play, trigger a random effect: discard a card / lose 3 Max HP / gain 20 Spore / lose 20 Heat / gain 4 Zhongdu / lose 1 Energy / take 5 damage / Binbang gains 1 Thorns / add Exhaust to a random card in your hand.
BINBANG_FLIGHT_POWER.title: Flight
BINBANG_FLIGHT_POWER.description: Damage taken is halved. Loses 1 stack each time it is hit by an attack; when it reaches 0, Binbang loses Flight and enters a Dive.
BINBANG_FLIGHT_POWER.smartDescription: Damage taken is halved. After [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more hits, Binbang loses Flight and enters a Dive.
CURSE_POWER.title: Curse
CURSE_POWER.description: Whenever you play Friendship Horn, Panacea, Cursed Skull, The Hand Lantern of Faery, Pandora Box, The Book of Bones or Leader Trumpet, you take 10 damage.
CURSE_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you play Friendship Horn, Panacea, Cursed Skull, The Hand Lantern of Faery, Pandora Box, The Book of Bones or Leader Trumpet, you take 10 damage.
WORSEN_POWER.title: Worsen
WORSEN_POWER.description: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Doom. Whenever Binbang is attacked, a Dazed is shuffled into your draw pile.
WORSEN_POWER.smartDescription: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Doom. Whenever Binbang is attacked, a Dazed is shuffled into your draw pile.
INSANE_POWER.title: Insane
INSANE_POWER.description: When this character dies, it will do something unknown.
INSANE_POWER.smartDescription: When this character dies, it will do something unknown.
